summary: Show a workspace organized around making or repairing a chosen object so tools and stations have narrative roles.
objective: Every prominent tool or station relates to the stated task, and animated parts do not pass through the bench or the operator workspace.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a industrial workshop narrative
Use maker workshop as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Build a repair workshop around an exploded clock assembly with selectable parts and a resettable repair sequence.

principles: Show a workspace organized around making or repairing a chosen object so tools and stations have narrative roles.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Give the hero assembly clear parts and place support jigs, storage and work surfaces along a plausible authored workflow.
Contrast clean working faces with selected handled surfaces; use local task lights and enough fill to expose the construction.
Begin at the main workbench and let the user isolate an assembly; motion should demonstrate a chosen process step with clear start and reset.
observable_checks: Every prominent tool or station relates to the stated task, and animated parts do not pass through the bench or the operator workspace.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with technical illustration or cinematic staging; depicted machinery needs a separate model before claiming operational or safety accuracy.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
